nodes.name: Classify Outlook Graph Poll Network Error

parameters.jsCode:
const request = $("Build Outlook Graph Poll Request").item.json;
return { json: { graphError: true, statusCode: null, retryAfterSeconds: null, attempt: request.attempt, retry: request.attempt < 3 } };
const item = $input.first().json; return [{ json: { attempt: item.attempt + 1 } }];

nodes.name: Classify Outlook Graph Retry Network Error

parameters.jsCode:
const request = $("Prepare Outlook Graph Retry").item.json;
return { json: { graphError: true, statusCode: null, retryAfterSeconds: null, attempt: request.attempt, retry: request.attempt < 3 } };
return $input.all().map(item => ({ json: { outcome: item.json.graphError ? "graph-poll-failed", httpStatus: item.json.statusCode ?? null, retryExhausted: item.json.retry === false } }));
const request = $input.item.json; return { json: { payload: request.payload, correlationId: request.correlationId, providerMessageId: request.providerMessageId, attempt: request.attempt + 1 } };

nodes.name: Classify Outlook API Retry Network Error

parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().filter(item => item.json.valid !== true).map(item => ({ json: { outcome: "message-quarantined", reason: item.json.reason, providerMessageId: item.json.providerMessageId ?? null } }));
